pc-still.prompt: Photorealistic candid photo. A high school student sits at a desk in a softly lit bedroom in the evening, seen over their right shoulder from behind, looking at a large desktop monitor. The monitor shows a flat, evenly lit chroma-key green screen that fills the display edge to edge: no text, no interface, no logos, no reflections, no glare. The whole monitor and its four corners are in frame, sharp; the student's head and shoulder overlap the lower left of the screen a little. An open notebook and a pencil on the desk. Natural warm lamp light, 35mm, shallow depth of field on the background only.
pc-still.why: A real-looking person at a real desk, for the ad to play on their screen: code and Blender can't make that believable.

pc.prompt: Locked-off camera, no camera movement, no cuts. The student leans in slightly toward the monitor, rests their chin on one hand, then sits back a little; small, natural movements only. The monitor keeps showing a flat, evenly lit chroma-key green screen, edge to edge, with no text or interface, for the whole shot.
pc.why: The same person in motion, so the ad playing on their screen sits in a real moment.
